name: Chipotle Cilantro Lime Rice
desc: Copycat Chipotle rice: basmati boiled with a bay leaf, then tossed with cilantro, lime, and lemon.

source.title: Chipotle Cilantro-Lime Rice (Copycat)
source.evidence: Same ingredient list and the same four methods (basmati pasta method, long-grain absorption, rice cooker, brown rice times), nearly word for word.

ingredients.raw: 2 cups basmati rice (unrinsed), or any long-grain white rice (rinsed)
ingredients.note: unrinsed; or any long-grain white rice, rinsed

ingredients.raw: 2 tsp kosher salt, plus about 1/4 tsp to finish
1 tsp olive oil or rice bran oil (optional)
ingredients.item: olive oil or rice bran oil

steps: Basmati, pasta method: Bring 8 cups water to a boil in a large pot. Add the rice, bay leaf, oil if using, and 2 tsp salt. Stir, return to a boil, and boil uncovered 10 to 12 minutes, until tender.
Basmati, pasta method: Remove the bay leaf. Drain the rice in a fine mesh strainer, rinse with hot water, and pour into a large bowl.

Other long-grain rice, absorption method: Bring 4 cups water to a boil. Add the rinsed rice, bay leaf, oil if using, and 2 tsp salt; return to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook 15 minutes. Remove the bay leaf.
Rice cooker: Add the rinsed rice, water per the manufacturer, the bay leaf, 1 tsp salt, and the oil if using. Cook per the cooker's instructions, then remove the bay leaf.
Brown rice: Follow the same steps, cooking 40 minutes for basmati on the stove, 45 minutes for other long-grain on the stove, or 60 to 70 minutes in a rice cooker.
To finish any method: Stir in the cilantro, lime juice, and lemon juice. Season with about 1/4 tsp more salt, to taste. Serve hot or at room temperature.
tips: Start checking the basmati at 10 minutes; some cooks find 12 minutes turns it mushy.
Parsley can stand in for the cilantro.
